audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 1-3 of the level chart contradicted their own prose and the packet chart: whys[1] says Gragas out-trades at 2 but win[1]/phases[1].side said Gangplank; whys[2] literally ends 'so it's a skill window' but the chart said Gangplank; whys[3] says 'the trade tilts to him' but the chart said Skill.
audit.why: Packet levelChart reads Gragas, Gragas, Skill, Gangplank, Skill, Gangplank, Gangplank. Rows 1, 2 and 3 of both layers were shifted one position out of step with it and with the whys text.
audit.corrected: phases[1].side/win[1] -> Gragas, phases[2].side/win[2] -> Skill, phases[3].side/win[3] -> Gangplank, with the three phases[].why strings rewritten to state the actual reason. Proposed as one atomic chart group.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer tracked 'Powder Kegs's cooldown' as the matchup-defining timer. Powder Keg has no meaningful cooldown (kit lists cd 0 — it is charge-based), so the advice was untrackable.
audit.why: The timer that actually decides commits is Remove Scurvy at 22/20/18/16/14, alongside Body Slam at 14s and Explosive Cask at 100s at rank 1.
audit.corrected: tldr, winCon, breakdown.cooldowns and the trade lines now key off Remove Scurvy's 22s and carry Body Slam's 14s and Cask's 100s.

audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive interaction was absent from the full layer: Remove Scurvy cures crowd control, so it cleanses Body Slam's stun and Barrel Roll's slow and heals on top. tradeBad also stated a whiffed E as '13 seconds'.
audit.why: Body Slam is 14/13.5/13/12.5/12 — 14s at rank 1, not 13. Remove Scurvy cleansing the stun is what turns a won all-in into a lost one, and it is stated in the content layer but nowhere in the full layer.
audit.corrected: tldr, tradeBad, dontsFull[2].d and breakdown.cooldowns now state the cleanse-and-heal interaction and the correct 14s figure.

audit.why: Both suspect names flagged in the packet — 'Drunken Rage's' and 'Use Explosive Cask' — are the correct ability names (one possessive, one preceded by a verb). False positives, as the mirror also found.
audit.corrected: No name changes made to spikes[0].text or wants.you[2].

edits.before: Pop his barrels — E-Q burst early before he scales. Gragas wins by trading around Gangplank's Powder Kegs and cashing the pattern: deny barrels and burst him early.
edits.after: Pop his barrels — Body Slam burst at 6, but only when Remove Scurvy is down: it cleanses your stun and slow and heals him back, and it is 22s at rank 1.

edits.before: Deny barrels and burst him early. Track Powder Kegs before every commit and keep the wave on your side.
edits.after: Deny barrels and burst him early. Track Remove Scurvy — 22s at rank 1 — before every commit and hold the wave.

edits.before: Q-poke Gangplank on cooldown from fog angles, W as he answers, and E-slam only when his key tool is down.
edits.after: Barrel Roll him mid-keg-placement, Drunken Rage as he answers, Body Slam only once Remove Scurvy is spent.

edits.before: Body-slamming INTO his answer — a whiffed E is 13 seconds of being a barrel with no plan.
edits.after: Body Slam into a held Remove Scurvy — he cleanses the stun and a whiffed E is 14s of downtime.

edits.before: Body-slamming INTO his answer — a whiffed E is 13 seconds of being a barrel with no plan.
edits.after: Body Slam into a held Remove Scurvy — he cleanses the stun and a whiffed E is 14s of downtime.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Trinity Force barrels chunk faster than Happy Hour heals it back.

edits.before: - Gangplank Powder Kegs: matchup-defining — Pop barrels to deny poke + gold. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Gangplank Remove Scurvy: matchup-defining — cleanses your Body Slam stun and Barrel Roll slow and heals him; 22s at rank 1. - Body Slam: 14s, never spend it on chip. - Explosive Cask: 100s — kill windows only.

edits.before: W damage reduction + sustain flips his return trade. Only take the trade when Gangplank's Powder Kegs is down.
edits.after: Q+W online: Drunken Rage's empowered auto plus Happy Hour out-trades a lone unchained keg. Walk up now.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Gangplank must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: His keg cooldowns roughly cancel your Barrel Roll and Body Slam downtime — trade when a keg is down, give nothing when it is up.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Powder Kegs's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Sheen unlocks empowered Parrrley and chained barrels that catch you, and Remove Scurvy cleanses your slow — the trade tilts to him.

notes: Chart rows 1-3 flipped in both layers as one atomic group to match the packet chart and the existing whys text. Row 0 left as Skill in both layers even though the packet says Gragas: whys[0] tells the player to soak poke and last-hit, which reads as neutral, and I would rather flag the disagreement than invent a Level 1 Gragas advantage. Powder Keg's kit cooldown is 0 (charge-based), so 'track his Powder Kegs cooldown' was unactionable advice throughout the full layer — retargeted onto Remove Scurvy.
